acquisition method: The Q-Exactive was operated in data-dependent mode with survey scans acquired at a resolution of 70 000.
alkylation reagent: then alkylated with 9 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min (room temperature) protected from light
alkylation concentration: then alkylated with 9 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma) for 30 min (room temperature) protected from light
cleavage agent: Proteomic-grade trypsin (Sigma) was added at a protein:trypsin ratio of 50:1 and incubated at 37°C overnight.
collision energy: fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation with normalized collision energies of 30.
fragmentation method: fragmented by higher energy collisional dissociation with normalized collision energies of 30.
instrument: coupled with a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
ionization type: fused to a silica nano-electrospray emitter (Dionex).
labeling: Peptide intensities were normalized against the reference run by Progenesis LC-MS and these intensities are used to highlight relative differences in protein expression between samples.
reduction reagent: reduced with 3 mM DTT at 60°C for 10 min
reduction concentration: reduced with 3 mM DTT at 60°C for 10 min
